scenarios.name: patient_profile_full
scenarios.title: Full patient profile (demographics and identifiers)
scenarios.description: Retrieve full patient including person demographics and identifiers.
scenarios.notes: Use v=full; parse person names, addresses, attributes, identifiers.

scenarios.name: patient_identifiers
scenarios.title: List patient identifiers
scenarios.description: Return patient identifiers with types and locations using a custom representation.
scenarios.notes: Tailored to return only identifiers.

scenarios.name: current_medications
scenarios.title: Current medications for a patient
scenarios.description: Return active medication orders (drug orders) for the patient.
examples: What medications is this patient currently on?
scenarios.notes: Uses /order with t=drugorder and patient filter; flags ensure only active, non-voided, non-expired orders.

scenarios.name: drug_orders_history
scenarios.title: Medication orders history
scenarios.description: Return recent medication orders (any status) for the patient.
scenarios.notes: Include stopped/expired orders for a more complete history. Add date filters if needed.

scenarios.name: test_orders_recent
scenarios.title: Recent test orders
scenarios.description: Return recent test orders for the patient.
scenarios.notes: Use additional filters like concepts or activation dates when needed.

scenarios.name: orders_by_concepts
scenarios.title: Orders by concepts
scenarios.description: Return orders for specified concept(s) for the patient.
scenarios.notes: Provide one or more concept UUIDs (comma-separated). Use concept resolver first if only names are known.

scenarios.name: recent_vitals_summary
scenarios.title: Recent vitals: blood pressure, temperature, weight
scenarios.description: Fetch the most recent encounters for a patient and let the AI extract BP, temperature, and weight from nested obs.
examples: retrieve recent blood pressure, temperature, weight
scenarios.notes: Full rep includes observations. AI should parse obs for systolic/diastolic BP, temperature, and weight.

scenarios.name: bp_trend
scenarios.title: Blood pressure trend
scenarios.description: Fetch recent encounters with BP observations for trend analysis.
scenarios.notes: Use resolver to map concept names to UUIDs. Extract systolic/diastolic from encounter obs.

scenarios.name: weight_trend
scenarios.title: Weight trend
scenarios.description: Fetch recent encounters with weight observations for trend analysis.
scenarios.notes: Use local concept dictionary naming.

scenarios.name: temperature_trend
scenarios.title: Temperature trend
scenarios.description: Fetch recent encounters with temperature observations for trend analysis.
scenarios.notes: Units may vary; AI should normalize if needed.

scenarios.name: last_visit_summary
scenarios.title: Summarize the last clinic visit
scenarios.description: Fetch the most recent encounter for the patient and summarize diagnoses, orders, notes, and providers.
examples: Summarize the last clinic visit for this patient
what happened in the last visit?
scenarios.notes: Optionally add encounterType to narrow to visit-related types if needed. Full rep includes obs, orders, providers.

scenarios.name: patient_encounters_recent
scenarios.title: Recent encounters
scenarios.description: List recent encounters for the patient.
scenarios.notes: General-purpose encounter listing.

scenarios.name: patient_encounters_by_type
scenarios.title: Encounters by type
scenarios.description: List encounters by type for the patient.
scenarios.notes: Resolve encounterType UUID externally if only a name is provided.

scenarios.name: patient_encounters_by_date_range
scenarios.title: Encounters within date range
scenarios.description: List encounters for the patient within a date range.
scenarios.notes: Dates should be ISO (YYYY-MM-DD).

scenarios.name: observations_by_concept_name
scenarios.title: Recent observations for a concept
scenarios.description: Fetch recent encounters filtered by a concept and extract observation values.
scenarios.notes: Use 'resolve' step to map concept name to UUID via /concept?q=... before calling this scenario.

scenarios.name: observations_by_concept_in_date_range
scenarios.title: Observations for a concept within date range
scenarios.description: Fetch encounters filtered by a concept for a given date range and extract observation values.
scenarios.notes: Ensure concept UUID is resolved first.

scenarios.name: recent_lab_results_wbc
scenarios.title: Recent WBC lab results
scenarios.description: Fetch encounters filtered by observations matching the WBC concept, then let AI extract numeric results and dates.
examples: What are the recent test results on WBC
scenarios.notes: Resolve WBC concept if not known; parse obs values from encounters.

scenarios.name: create_patient_allergy
scenarios.title: Create patient allergy
scenarios.description: Create an allergy subresource for the patient.
scenarios.notes: Requires concept UUIDs for allergen/severity/reactions; resolve with /concept if needed. All four are in requiredContext because the body templates them unconditionally -- omitting one previously POSTed an allergy with an empty uuid instead of failing the precondition check.

scenarios.name: get_patient_allergy_by_uuid
scenarios.title: Get patient allergy by UUID
scenarios.description: Fetch a specific patient allergy subresource by UUID.
scenarios.notes: List-all endpoint may not be present in this swagger; use by-uuid retrieval when known.

scenarios.name: resolve_concept_uuid_by_name
scenarios.title: Resolve concept UUID by name
scenarios.description: Utility: resolve a concept UUID by searching its name.
scenarios.notes: Use first/highest-ranked match or apply additional disambiguation.
